# Forgeboard

Forgeboard is a B2B SaaS workflow product for engineering teams. Subscription pricing is sold per seat to software companies that need one workspace for planning, release coordination, and incident review.

## Who it is for

Forgeboard is built for mid-market engineering organizations of 40 to 400 employees, from Series A through Series C. Buyers are engineering managers, platform teams, and SRE leads.

## Integrations

Native integrations with GitHub, GitLab, Jira, Slack, PagerDuty, and Linear. A public REST API and webhook catalog let teams extend the workspace into the rest of their toolchain.

## Security and compliance

Forgeboard is SOC 2 Type II compliant. SSO via SAML and SCIM provisioning are included on the Business plan. Audit logs are retained for 12 months.

## Pricing

Public plans, with self-serve signup for Starter and Growth:

- Starter — $18 per seat / month, billed annually, up to 25 seats.
- Growth — $36 per seat / month. Unlimited projects and priority support.
- Business — $64 per seat / month. SSO, SCIM, audit logs, and a named customer success manager.

## Customers

- Northwind Analytics reduced release-coordination time by 37% in one quarter.
- Helio Payments consolidated four internal tools after rolling Forgeboard out to 180 engineers.
- Lumenstack cut incident handoff delays from 4 hours to 40 minutes.

## Problems engineering teams bring to Forgeboard

- Status updates live in five tools and nobody trusts the latest version.
- Release checklists fall out of date the moment an incident starts.
- Cross-team dependencies stay invisible until a deadline slips.
